title: Repair Node 22 clean-install lockfile for semantic CI
description: Observed GitHub CI runs37321152153 and37318613548: npm ci fails before all Web/Gherkin tests with EUSAGE Missing @opentelemetry/core@2.0.0 from lock file (four occurrences). Existing local node_modules hides this clean-install defect. Purpose restore exact Node22/npm10 clean installation before closing e426b3. Allowed only web/package-lock.json and focused regression evidence if needed; package.json dependency version changes require root review. Exclude product behavior, model/browser download, AWS deploys, git/Kanbus mutations by Terra. Use Node22/npm10 matching Actions, first reproduce RED with npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts in isolated directory containing copied package manifests (do not erase live node_modules). Regenerate lock mechanically using matching package manager while preserving intended direct dependency versions; no blanket library upgrade or --legacy-peer-deps workaround. Verify GREEN clean npm ci in isolated copy, both typechecks, npm run test:semantic and node features/data/check-steps.mjs. Handoff exact Node/npm versions, RED/GREEN counts, lock diff summary and any unresolved package-engine/peer blockers. Root reruns checks, commits and pushes one scoped fix, then closes after hosted CI succeeds. Do not claim dependency vulnerability advisories resolved by this packet.
right_now_summary: The lockfile is being repaired and clean Node 22/npm 10 installation checks are being rerun.
